variable.content: variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w}

comp.content: def comp {α β γ} (g : β → γ) (f : α → β) : α → γ := fun x => g (f x)

id.content: def id {α} : α → α := fun x => x

comp_assoc.content: axiom comp_assoc : ∀ {α β γ δ} (h : γ → δ) (g : β → γ) (f : α → β), comp h (comp g f) = comp (comp h g) f

comp_id_l.content: axiom comp_id_l  : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β), comp (id) f = f

comp_id_r.content: axiom comp_id_r  : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β), comp f id = f

commute.content: def commute {α} (f g : α → α) : Prop := comp f g = comp g f

commute_symm.content:
theorem commute_symm {α} (f g : α → α) : commute f g → commute g f :=
by
  intro H
  have : comp f g = comp g f := H
  have Hsym : comp g f = comp f g := by
    exact Eq.symm this
  exact Hsym

commute_with_id_l.content:
theorem commute_with_id_l {α} (f : α → α) : commute f (id) :=
by
  unfold commute
  have H1 : comp f id = f := comp_id_r f
  have H2 : comp id f = f := comp_id_l f
  have : comp f id = comp id f := by
    simp [H1, H2]
  exact this

commute_with_id_r.content:
theorem commute_with_id_r {α} (f : α → α) : commute (id) f :=
by
  unfold commute
  have H1 : comp id f = f := comp_id_l f
  have H2 : comp f id = f := comp_id_r f
  have : comp id f = comp f id := by
    simp [H1, H2]
  exact this

commute_refl.content:
theorem commute_refl {α} (f : α → α) : commute f f :=
by
  unfold commute
  rfl

commute_congr.content:
theorem commute_congr {α} (f1 f2 g1 g2 : α → α) :
  f1 = f2 → g1 = g2 → commute f1 g1 → commute f2 g2 :=
by
  intro Hf Hg Hc
  subst Hf
  subst Hg
  exact Hc

commute_transport_left_id.content:
theorem commute_transport_left_id {α} (f g : α → α) :
  commute f g → commute (comp (id) f) g :=
by
  intro H
  unfold commute at *
  simpa [comp_id_l] using H

commute_transport_right_id.content:
theorem commute_transport_right_id {α} (f g : α → α) :
  commute f g → commute f (comp (id) g) :=
by
  intro H
  unfold commute at *
  simpa [comp_id_l] using H

comp.content: Definition comp {α β γ : Type} (g : β -> γ) (f : α -> β) : α -> γ := fun x => g (f x).

id.content: Definition id {α : Type} : α -> α := fun x => x.

commute.content: Definition commute {α : Type} (f g : α -> α) : Prop := comp f g = comp g f.

commute_symm.content:
Lemma commute_symm : forall {α} (f g : α -> α), commute f g -> commute g f.
  Proof.
    intros α f g H.
    unfold commute in *.
    rewrite H.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

commute_with_id_l.content:
Lemma commute_with_id_l : forall {α} (f : α -> α), commute f (@id α).
  Proof.
    intros α f.
    unfold commute.
    rewrite comp_id_r.
    rewrite comp_id_l.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

commute_with_id_r.content:
Lemma commute_with_id_r : forall {α} (f : α -> α), commute (@id α) f.
  Proof.
    intros α f.
    unfold commute.
    rewrite comp_id_l.
    rewrite comp_id_r.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

commute_refl.content:
Lemma commute_refl : forall {α} (f : α -> α), commute f f.
  Proof.
    intros α f.
    unfold commute.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

commute_congr.content:
Lemma commute_congr : forall {α} (f1 f2 g1 g2 : α -> α),
    f1 = f2 -> g1 = g2 -> commute f1 g1 -> commute f2 g2.
  Proof.
    intros α f1 f2 g1 g2 Hf Hg Hc.
    subst f2. subst g2.
    exact Hc.
  Qed.

commute_transport_left_id.content:
Lemma commute_transport_left_id : forall {α} (f g : α -> α),
    commute f g -> commute (comp (@id α) f) g.
  Proof.
    intros α f g H.
    unfold commute in *.
    rewrite comp_id_l.
    exact H.
  Qed.

commute_transport_right_id.content:
Lemma commute_transport_right_id : forall {α} (f g : α -> α),
    commute f g -> commute f (comp (@id α) g).
  Proof.
    intros α f g H.
    unfold commute in *.
    rewrite comp_id_l.
    exact H.
  Qed.

comp_assoc.content: comp_assoc : forall {α β γ δ} (h : γ -> δ) (g : β -> γ) (f : α -> β), comp h (comp g f) = comp (comp h g) f;

comp_id_l.content: comp_id_l  : forall {α β} (f : α -> β), comp (@id β) f = f;

comp_id_r.content: comp_id_r  : forall {α β} (f : α -> β), comp f (@id α) = f
